newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ENGLAND'S PEARCE TO LEAVE NOTTINGHAM FOREST.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ENGLAND'S PEARCE TO LEAVE NOTTINGHAM FOREST.

text.p: England defender Stuart Pearce, seeking to return to the premier league to keep his World Cup prospects alive, has been given a free transfer by relegated Nottingham Forest.

Manager Dave Bassett confirmed the free transfer and newspapers quoted the 35-year-old player on Thursday as saying it was time for change after 12 years at Forest and despite having three years left on his contract.
"Playing for England means so much to me. It will be a wrench to leave Forest, but its time to move on," said Pearce.
The Forest captain, a no-nonsense defender dubbed "Psycho" by the fans, was briefly the caretaker manager at the once-great club after Frank Clark left last December.
Pearce moved to Nottingham from Coventry, his first league club, for 240,000 pounds ($402,000) in 1985 and has made more than 500 appearances for Forest since then.
"I've had 12 marvellous years at Forest that I wouldn't swap for anything," Pearce said.
Newspapers said that London was the player's most likely destination with West Ham, who have been interested in Pearce previously, the prime candidates.
